purpose: Single source of truth for Riviera recipe naming where the same kitchen recipe appears under multiple menu names.

polpette.service_rule: Use the Polpette recipe as the single kitchen base for meatballs, albondigas and polpette unless a future menu deliberately creates a separate recipe.
polpette.cocktail_size_rule: 60 g pre-crumb is the normal cocktail standard. 80 g is substantial canape only if explicitly requested.
polpette.duplicate_rule: Do not use beef-polpette-canape or slow-cooked-beef-albondigas-buffet as separate active recipes. They are older service-format drafts and should redirect to the canonical Polpette recipe.
notes: Do not create separate active recipes for meatballs, albondigas and polpette without a deliberate menu decision.
Older DOCX wording may use veal meatballs or albondigas. Treat those as aliases, not separate production recipes.
The GitHub expansion draft beef-polpette-canape is not a separate production recipe; use the canonical 60 g Polpette standard instead.
The GitHub expansion draft slow-cooked-beef-albondigas-buffet is a buffet service wording/variant, not a separate production recipe.
